rounds.text: TGB Banquets & Hotels Ltd is currently trading at a significant discount to its intrinsic value, with a price-to-book ratio of 0.36x [E2] compared to a sector benchmark of 2.3x [E7]. This valuation gap is further highlighted by a discounted cash flow analysis that suggests an intrinsic value of Rs 20 per share, providing a margin of safety of 51.2% [E45, E46, E69]. While the stock has struggled with long-term sales contraction [E14], the company has demonstrated a turnaround in momentum with 21% compounded sales growth over the last five years [E15]. Fundamentals are currently outpacing price action, as evidenced by 18% profit growth over five years compared to only 1% price growth [E56]. Furthermore, the reverse DCF indicates that the current market price only requires 8.2% earnings growth to be justified, which is well below the 18% growth assumed in the base case [E47]. Conceded: [E4], [E14], [E16], [E17], [E71], [E72].
